Captured from a live herdr 0.9.0 server (protocol 22) through the dsh 0.2.1-alpha.1
api-gateway: each file is the `result` field of the `server-response` frame for
`herdr/dashboard` and `herdr/status` (scope `all`), i.e. the `{ ok, value }` Result
envelope the client remote returns. Host name, paths, pane titles and terminal output
were redacted.
